feats.title: Bolstered Swarm
feats.description: When you use wild shape to change from your humanoid form to beast form, you gain 5 + your Constitution temporary hit points. The temporary hit points increase to 10 + your Constitution at 21st level.

feats.title: Bolstering Guardian
feats.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with a druid attack power, one ally adjacent to you gains temporary hit points equal to your Constitution.

feats.title: Brutal Grappler Form
feats.description: While you are in beast form, you gain a +2 feat bonus to grab attempts. Additionally, any target you are grabbing while in beast form grants you combat advantage.

feats.title: Commanding Form
feats.description: Once per round while you are in beast form, you can use a free action to give one of your summoned creatures a command that normally requires a minor action.

feats.title: Fierce Thrasher Form
feats.description: While you are in beast form and use a beast form power that pushes, pulls, or slides the target, increase the distance of the push, pull, or slide by 1 square.

feats.title: Hunting Wolf Form
feats.description: While you are in beast form, you gain a +5 feat bonus to Perception checks and a +1 feat bonus to speed.

feats.title: Pouncing Form
feats.description: When you use wild shape to change from your humanoid form to beast form, you can shift a number of squares equal to your Dexterity.

feats.title: Quick Wild Shape
feats.description: You can use your wild shape power as a free action during your turn.

feats.title: Scattering Swarm
feats.description: While you are in beast form, if you take damage from an area or a close attack, you can shift 2 squares as a free action.

feats.title: Scuttling Crawler Form
feats.description: While you are in beast form, you gain a +5 feat bonus to Athletics checks to climb and can climb at your speed.

feats.title: Stalking Panther Form
feats.description: While you are in beast form, you gain a +5 feat bonus to Stealth checks and a +4 feat bonus to initiative checks.

feats.title: Venomous Fang Form
feats.description: While you are in beast form, all your melee attacks with the poison keyword ignore the first 10 points of the target's poison resist. This increases to 15 points at 21st level.

feats.title: Vital Form
feats.description: Once per encounter, when you use wild shape, you regain the use of your second wind if you have already used it during this encounter.

feats.title: Warning Guardian
feats.description: Any ally adjacent to you doesn't grant combat advantage for being flanked.
